annotations.label: Every data source disclosed
annotations.note: Lists each monitored data source and what is never collected, before monitoring is used.
States the local-first model: no account and no cloud upload; pause is always available.

annotations.label: Agents found from config locations
annotations.note: Agents detected from known installation/configuration paths on this machine (demo profile).
One-click integration: writes the agent's native hook or telemetry configuration after creating a backup.

annotations.label: Navigation
annotations.note: Monitor, Inventory, Activity and Manage sections; the Threats badge shows open alerts from the last 24 hours.

annotations.label: Time range
annotations.note: Global time range (15 minutes to 30 days) applied to every chart and table.

annotations.label: KPIs
annotations.note: Active agents, sessions, event rate, commands, file changes, tool/MCP calls, network connections and detections. Each tile links to its detail page.

annotations.label: Activity by agent
annotations.note: Stacked event counts per interval, one colour per agent; hover for values, click a column to open that window in the Timeline.

annotations.label: Risk & agent distribution
annotations.note: Sessions grouped by risk level and events per agent for the selected range.

annotations.label: Monitoring state
annotations.note: Current monitoring state and one-click pause/resume.

annotations.label: Detections by severity
annotations.note: Detections over time, stacked by severity.

annotations.label: Top rules
annotations.note: Most frequent rules with severity; click to filter the Threats view.

annotations.label: Top commands
annotations.note: Most frequent commands, tools and workspaces for the range.

annotations.label: Pause / resume
annotations.note: Freezes the stream for inspection without stopping collection.

annotations.label: Filter
annotations.note: Client-side filters by text, agent and minimum severity.

annotations.label: Event stream
annotations.note: Virtualised list of normalised events: time (ms), agent, type, severity, summary and source (hook, otlp, process, synthetic…).

annotations.label: Rate
annotations.note: Observed events per second and the number of rows shown.

annotations.label: Normalised fields
annotations.note: Schema fields: agent, session, source/fidelity, process, workspace, correlation and trace ids, labels.

annotations.label: Redacted payload
annotations.note: Type-specific payload after secret redaction and privacy minimisation.

annotations.label: Copy JSON
annotations.note: Copies the complete event for use in tickets or other tools.

annotations.label: Severity summary
annotations.note: Open incidents and detection counts per severity and policy violations for the range.

annotations.label: Views & filters
annotations.note: Incidents vs. all detections; status (open/acknowledged/suppressed); minimum severity; search.

annotations.label: Incident
annotations.note: Alerts from the same session within 30 minutes are grouped into one incident; ×N shows de-duplicated repeats.

annotations.label: Triage
annotations.note: Acknowledge, suppress or reopen each alert.

annotations.label: Dimensions
annotations.note: Detections by risk dimension.

annotations.label: Classification
annotations.note: Observation, suspicious indicator or confirmed policy violation; nothing is labelled malicious from pattern alone.

annotations.label: Recommended action
annotations.note: Rule-specific next step for the analyst.

annotations.label: Evidence
annotations.note: Matched snippet with surrounding context.

annotations.label: Triggering event
annotations.note: The full (redacted) event that produced the detection.

annotations.label: Search & severity
annotations.note: Server-side search across event summaries, filtered by minimum severity.

annotations.label: Export
annotations.note: Exports the current query as JSONL or CSV (CSV cells are neutralised against formula injection).

annotations.label: Correlated events
annotations.note: All agents in one timeline with session ids; drill-down filters (agent, session, correlation id, type, workspace) arrive from other pages.

annotations.label: Filter & sort
annotations.note: Search by session, workspace or agent; active-only filter; sort by recency, risk or event count.

annotations.label: Session inventory
annotations.note: Agent, session id, workspace, start, duration, event count, status and risk score per session.

annotations.label: Session summary
annotations.note: Agent, start, duration, event count, detections and risk score.

annotations.label: Event groups
annotations.note: Filter the timeline to commands, files, tools, network or security events.

annotations.label: Replay
annotations.note: Step through the session in order; later events fade until reached.

annotations.label: Timeline
annotations.note: Millisecond timestamps, event type, severity, summary, duration and source; tool results and detections indent under their correlated call.

annotations.label: Risk explanation
annotations.note: Score, per-dimension breakdown and every contributing factor with points, confidence and evidence.

annotations.label: Expanded detection
annotations.note: Expanding an event shows its payload with links to the raw event and its parent (correlated) event.

annotations.label: Node types
annotations.note: Toggle agents, sessions, processes, commands, files, directories, tools, MCP servers, network endpoints and security events.

annotations.label: Force-directed graph
annotations.note: Nodes are sized by occurrences; rings mark elevated risk; edges are typed (executed, read, modified, called, connected_to, detected_by). Drag nodes, pan and zoom.

annotations.label: Selection
annotations.note: Selecting a node highlights its direct neighbours and shows occurrences, maximum risk and connection count, with navigation actions.

annotations.label: Activity by agent
annotations.note: Command executions over time, per agent.

annotations.label: Top binaries
annotations.note: Most used executables; click to focus the table.

annotations.label: Commands
annotations.note: Each command with agent, severity and fidelity (observed vs. inferred).

annotations.label: Top directories
annotations.note: Directories with the most read/write activity.

annotations.label: File operations
annotations.note: Reads, modifications, creations, deletions and directory access with paths; contents are never stored.

annotations.label: MCP inventory
annotations.note: Servers found in agent configuration files: client, transport, command/URL and environment variable names (never values).

annotations.label: Destinations
annotations.note: Most contacted destinations for the range (connection metadata only: host/IP and port).

annotations.label: First-seen destinations
annotations.note: Destinations outside the allowlist, first seen per agent.

annotations.label: Policies
annotations.note: User-defined policies with enable switch, mode (observe / alert / require approval), severity and scope; edited as validated JSON.

annotations.label: Mode
annotations.note: Require approval returns an "ask" decision to agents that support blocking hooks.

annotations.label: Rule catalogue
annotations.note: Every built-in rule with description, severity, risk dimension, classification, references and a per-rule enable switch.

annotations.label: Usage trend
annotations.note: Events per agent per interval.

annotations.label: Activity by type
annotations.note: Commands, file operations, tool and MCP calls, network over time.

annotations.label: Agent comparison
annotations.note: Per-agent totals: events, sessions, commands, file changes, MCP calls, detections and peak event risk.

annotations.label: Risk trend
annotations.note: Detections over time by risk dimension.

annotations.label: Activity heatmap
annotations.note: Hour-of-week activity in local time.

annotations.label: Command categories
annotations.note: Commands grouped into categories such as version control, package & build, network.

annotations.label: Session durations
annotations.note: Distribution of session durations (log-scaled bins).

annotations.label: Baselines
annotations.note: Learned events-per-minute baseline per agent type used by the anomaly detector (learning until 30 samples).

annotations.label: Integrations
annotations.note: Hook and OpenTelemetry integrations per agent with config file and live status; enable/remove with automatic backup.

annotations.label: Local endpoints
annotations.note: Loopback API (token-authenticated) and OTLP/HTTP JSON receiver for any compatible agent.

annotations.label: Prompt retention
annotations.note: Metadata only (default), redacted text or full text.

annotations.label: Tool output
annotations.note: Metadata only (default) or redacted and truncated to 2 KB.

annotations.label: Always applied
annotations.note: Protections that cannot be switched off: secret redaction, no file contents, no outbound traffic by default, loopback-only API.

annotations.label: Background operation
annotations.note: Start at login and keep running in the tray.

annotations.label: Collectors
annotations.note: Each collector can be disabled; interval and workspace limits are configurable.

annotations.label: Alert routing
annotations.note: Alert threshold, desktop notification threshold, de-duplication window, optional webhook and suppressions.

annotations.note: A running agent identified by its process signature (here a Node.js agent framework), with pid and session link.

annotations.label: Descendant tree
annotations.note: Child and grandchild processes spawned by the agent, with pid, name, command line and age.

annotations.label: Inventory summary
annotations.note: Running, installed, historically observed and untrusted agent counts.

annotations.label: Filter & rescan
annotations.note: Filter by running/installed/observed; rescan known installation locations.

annotations.label: Agents
annotations.note: Status, runtime, version, live process ids, sessions, last activity, 24-hour risk and trust (unreviewed / trusted / untrusted).

annotations.label: Identity
annotations.note: Agent id, runtime, executable, install paths and declared adapter capabilities.

annotations.label: Live processes
annotations.note: Current root processes with child counts.

annotations.label: Sessions
annotations.note: Recent sessions with activity and risk; click to open the session timeline.

annotations.label: Pipeline counters
annotations.note: Stored, dropped and de-duplicated events, queue depth, CPU, memory, database size and uptime.

annotations.label: Latency
annotations.note: p50/p95 for pipeline, detection, storage, API and each collector.

annotations.label: Collectors
annotations.note: State, runs, failures, last run, duration and last error for each collector.
